label: VTE: rivaroxaban starting dose after day 21
title: Rivaroxaban starting dose supplied after day 21 of acute clot treatment
statement: 15 mg BID with food × 3 weeks then 20 mg once daily with food

source.document: Guidance for the practical management of the direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) in VTE treatment

plain_summary: A later supply still directs rivaroxaban 15 mg twice daily after the first 21 days of treatment for an acute clot.

medicine_groups.name: Rivaroxaban
medicine_groups.note: Multiply strength by tablets per dose, then by doses per day to get the daily dose. One 15 mg tablet twice daily gives 15 mg per dose and 30 mg per day. Food intake is outside this check. Count a later supply only if its directions still apply on that date. Pack size, an early refill or directions that step down on time do not establish continuation.

rule_for_models: For adults aged 18 or over, confirm this finding only when the starting record and a separate supply for the same acute deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism both direct rivaroxaban 15 mg twice daily and the later supply continues that dose on day 22 or later. Count the first dose, including any hospital dose, as day 1. At each supply, check the strength, tablets per dose and frequency. If the prescribed regimen is unclear, ask only about the point where it is missing. Accept the pharmacist's confirmation for that point in this course. A total of 30 mg per day alone leaves the frequency unknown. Cite both supplies, the evidence of the diagnosis and any pharmacist answer used for the indication, interval, course link or either regimen. Two compatible supplies at least 21 days apart can prompt a check, but the first visible fill alone does not establish day 1. If the pattern fits and age, indication, start, regimen or course link is unclear or not known, cite the available evidence and report only a possible finding naming what is missing. For this criterion, report no finding below age 18, within the first 21 treatment days, for a different indication, a new clot or a different prescribed regimen at either point, or for an early refill or an on-time step-down without continued high-dose directions.
cannot_be_seen: The first visible fill or discharge date alone cannot establish day 1. Hospital treatment and outside supplies may be missing. A supply does not show which doses the patient took. If the start is uncertain or the later supply could be for a new clot, the record cannot establish continued use for the same episode.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm the indication and first dose date, including any hospital doses, and review the current rivaroxaban directions for this course?

needs_facts.what: Acute deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism
needs_facts.meets: A dated diagnosis or the pharmacist's answer identifies an acute deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism in the episode under review.

needs_facts.meets: A dated first dose or the pharmacist's confirmation places the later supply on day 22 or later, counting any first dose in hospital as day 1.

options.words: First dose was 21 or more days before the later supply
First dose was less than 21 days before the later supply
